notes.title: Update: Version 1.07 Controller Support / Summer Sale Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing MASAGORO.
We have added support for controllers, which we announced at the time of release as one of our future plans.
In addition, we are offering a 15% discount on MASAGORO during summer sale.

[h1]Added Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Controller support
[/list] 
The game now supports controller operation.
For more information about the control keys, please refer to the "How to operate" section in the game.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bathroom door to disappear under certain circumstances.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing MASAGORO.

[h1]Glitches[/h1]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed text not progressing when language setting is English.

[/list]
